items.t: High-voltage battery can fail and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Battery management software update or high-voltage battery replacement under recall

items.t: Battery bus bar screws can cause sudden loss of drive power (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace high-voltage battery under recall

items.t: Won't start with a high-voltage system warning
items.job: High-voltage system diagnosis, contactor reset or interlock wiring repair
items.note: Often a reset or wiring repair rather than a major part. High-voltage components carry an 8-year/100,000-mile warranty.

items.t: Drive unit and DC fast-charging faults fixed by software update
items.job: Drive unit, battery management and charging software update
items.note: Done free by the dealer as a service campaign.

items.t: Fault messages when preconditioning or plugged in
items.note: Software fix, usually free under warranty.

items.t: Low coolant warning from electric drive cooling
items.job: Diagnose cooling circuit, bleed air and refill coolant
items.note: Usually covered under warranty on newer cars.

items.job: Drive unit seal repair per bulletin

items.t: Front drive unit gear can fail, risking rollaway (recall)
items.job: Replace front axle electric drive unit under recall
Replace second-row child seat anchor covers under recall

items.t: Weekly preconditioning schedule missing or grayed out
Knocking from rear axle on bumpy roads
items.job: Retighten rear shock absorber connection per bulletin

items.t: Brake, parking brake and stability warning lights come on
items.job: Brake system diagnosis and repair per bulletin

items.t: Steering gets heavier at parking speeds
items.job: Power steering diagnosis and software update

items.t: 'Active Emergency Stop Assist not available' warning
items.job: Steering wheel hand-detection repair per bulletin

items.note: Done free as a service campaign.

items.t: Clunk or noise from drive unit mount on acceleration
items.job: Remove and treat drive unit mount bearing per bulletin
